title: proteoform-regions: proteoform-aware region inference and detection-bias quantification from bottom-up proteomics
description: Software implementation of the pipeline from 'Basic-peptide depletion and precursor masking in bottom-up proteomics' (Saadat et al., 2026). Harmonizes heterogeneous peptide-level result tables (MaxQuant, DIA-NN, Spectronaut, Progenesis, mzIdentML, glycopeptide exports, FragPipe PSMs) into a tiered evidence schema; computes peptide/region pI and molecular weight; stitches detected regions; and quantifies acidic/basic detection bias against digestion-matched tryptic backgrounds.
